# awscc_apiportal_product_api_page (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ProductApiPage. Per-API documentation page attached to an AWS::APIPortal::Product.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product.

### Optional

- `display_content` (Attributes) Three-mode content: write with either Overrides or None; the service populates ApiUrl, OperationName and Body on Read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_content))
- `managed_api_id` (String) Identifier of the Managed API this page documents.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product API page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `try_it_state` (String) Whether the interactive TryIt UI is enabled for this API.

### Read-Only

- `api_id` (Attributes) The route (Path + Method) on the source-service resource, resolved from the Managed API's signature. One ResourceArn covers API Gateway, ALB, and CloudFront. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_id))
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `product_api_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product API page.
- `product_api_page_id` (String) The product API page identifier.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status of the API documentation.
- `status_exception` (Attributes) Reported when Status is FAILED. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_exception))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product API page was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--display_content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_content`

Optional:

- `none` (String) Marker selecting the default service-rendered content with no overrides.
- `overrides` (Attributes) Customer-supplied overrides for the service-rendered API documentation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_content--overrides))

Read-Only:

- `api_url` (String) Service-rendered API URL. Read-only.
- `body` (String) Service-rendered documentation body. Read-only.
- `operation_name` (String) Service-rendered operation name. Read-only.

Optional:

- `operation_name` (String) Override for the operation name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_api_page.example
  identity = {
    product_api_page_arn = "product_api_page_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_api_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product API page

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_api_page.example
  id = "product_api_page_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_product_api_page.example "product_api_page_arn"
```
